name: Pinku no Ayumi! ~Ikenai Ryoujoku Kensa~
original_name: ぴんくのあゆみ!～いけない陵辱検査～
source:
Main character's brother and rival gets in an accident. Protagonist decides to impersonate him to have some fun at brother's position - health doctor at a private girl school.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角的兄弟兼对手遭遇事故。主角决定冒充他来取乐哥哥的职位——私立女子学校的健康医生。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
